method: Independent directed Dijkstra per ordered pair, exact shared OSM node IDs, Haversine lengths of original consecutive vertices. No village-road connector, snapping, speed or ETA. Restricted/unknown access, unresolved conditionals and ways participating in turn restrictions are conservatively excluded.

coverage.limitation: 不完整的OSM道路样本；未记录限制不等于没有限制。古村到参考点无步行或上下客核验。不同来源获取日期不同；不提供出行导航、公交时间或车辆通行保证。
